request: UserCache should hold at most 100 users; drop the oldest one when it is full.
MainViewModel.refresh should do nothing when the id is blank.
Add a way to remove a single user from UserCache by id.
Add a has(id) method to UserCache.
UserService.refresh should log an error through the logger when loading fails, then rethrow.
shout should trim the display name before upper-casing it.
select(id:) should leave the current selection alone when no user has that id.
reset() should also clear the selected user.
